relationships.subject: Sodium channel Excitability Nociceptor Test
relationships.evidence_quote: The in silico model predicted that alterations in Nav1.7 can be classified at the group level (n = 30) with an accuracy of 92% and 50% at the individual level.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: Voltage-gated sodium channels have been studied extensively due to the strong correlation between sodium channel mutations and small fiber neuropathy.

key_findings: A 5-pulse excitability test (SENT) was designed in silico and predicts Nav1.7 alterations with 92% group-level accuracy (n=30) at 11% perception-threshold SD.
Automated patch clamp of Nav1.7 in HEK293T cells matched the in silico predicted peak current pattern.
